claims.text: The FDA label reports that quetiapine potentiated alcohol's cognitive and motor effects in a trial involving subjects with selected psychotic disorders.
claims.quote: Quetiapine potentiated the cognitive and motor effects of alcohol in a clinical trial in subjects with selected psychotic disorders

headline.text: The FDA label reports increased cognitive and motor effects of alcohol with quetiapine in a clinical trial.

reported.text: The trial involved subjects with selected psychotic disorders.
